title: Three Months and One Short Desk
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：job　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 job 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the supervisor ① took the job that no newcomer in the department would have recorded, and he said the taking was the whole of the week. The ② job, meaning the post itself and not the desk, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; a job, he said, is the only thing in a department that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ job in that department had the same short desk beside it, and the ④ job at the far corridor, meaning the task they kept for the children to try and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A job, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the supervisor said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the job was the whole of the matter, meaning the pride and not the post. The ⑥ job, meaning the pride and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; job, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a post and a pride. He said the pride is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ job had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short desk. The ⑧ job of the whole thing, the supervisor wrote in March, was one department and three weeks of recording; job, he said, is either the task at the far corridor or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ job I remember is the post recorded in the file, which closed in 1979 and is still recorded as the quietest in the department. A ⑩ job, my mother said in 1981, is the only post that improves by being recorded; every job, she said, is a pride that has agreed to look like a post. She said the pride was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 工作；职位（指部门里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 工作；职位（指那份岗位本身，与办公桌相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the job 接下这份工作
D. n. 工作；职位（指留给孩子们试的那一件那一份）
E. n. 履职之事（抽象总称，指一处部门的工作之事）
F. n. 工作；职位（指档案里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 体面、自尊（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 自尊（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the job that no newcomer in the department would have recorded
The job, meaning the post itself and not the desk
the job at the far corridor
the job was the whole of the matter
the job had become a line in a file
The job of the whole thing
A job, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: take the job 意为“接下这份工作”，1972 年那位主管把部门里没有一位新人肯记录的一份工作做了一遍。
job 意为“工作；职位”，指那份岗位本身而不是办公桌，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记录。
job 意为“工作；职位”，指部门里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一张窄窄的办公桌。
job 意为“工作；职位”，指最远那条走廊留给孩子们试的那一件那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
job 意为“体面、自尊”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份体面就是那件事的全部。
job 意为“自尊”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份岗位，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
job 意为“工作；职位”，指档案里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1977 年这一份成了档案里的一行。
job 意为“履职之事”，主管三月写道，整件事的工作之事是一处部门和三个星期的记录。
job 意为“工作；职位”，我记得的是档案里记录过的那一份，1979 年定岗了，至今仍被说成部门里最安静的一份。
job 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，工作是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的岗位。
